newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dah Sing to issue mortgage-backed notes.
newsitem.headline: Dah Sing to issue mortgage-backed notes.

text.p: Dah Sing Bank, a unit of Dah Sing Financial Holdings Ltd, said on Thursday it plans to launch a US$300 million AAA-rated mortgage securitisation in the form of notes.
The issue would be backed by a total of about HK$2.32 billion in mortgages held by Dah Sing Bank, it told reporters and analysts at a roadshow in Hong Kong.
It would be the largest cross-border mortgage or asset-backed issue originated in Asia, excluding Japan, the bank said.
The issue will be credit-enhanced to carry an AAA credit rating from Standard & Poor's and an Aaa rating from Moody's Investors Service, it said.
The notes will be listed in Luxembourg.
The launch date is expected to be June 18, it said.
